scope: General portable API26 Class.forName one-argument and name/initialize/ClassLoader overload using the one canonical application/bootstrap loader model. No package or game branches.
contract: Explicit ClassLoader argument is resolved through PackageService canonical provenance: application sees actual DEX plus modeled bootstrap classes; boot/null cannot see app DEX; unknown loaders fail explicitly
Validated binary names and array descriptors, rank1..255; reference components must exist and be visible; primitive/void names do not fabricate primitive Class objects
Required superclass/interface definitions are resolved without class initialization; missing requested class is ClassNotFoundException and missing required definition is NoClassDefFoundError
initialize=false and all arrays do not initialize component classes; initialize=true uses the actual Engine once/failed initialization state

Portable Engine propagates Java Error subclasses unchanged on first initializer failure, wraps non-Error exceptions in ExceptionInInitializerError, and preserves later NoClassDefFoundError poisoning; legacy std behavior unchanged
ClassLoader.loadClass shares the same bounded hierarchy-link helper and does not initialize
Canonical Class objects and canonical loader identities survive GC; exact implemented forName descriptors are advertised in the JNI method metadata catalog only

Initialization through an uninitialized default-bearing DEX interface is explicitly API_UNAVAILABLE before mutation. Explicit initialization of the interface is supported; dependent class initialization can then succeed

commands.note: Normal Android SDK compilation and JVM execution; expected obsolete Java release8 warnings only; MissingBase omitted from both JVM JAR and DEX inputs

limits: One application loader and one bootstrap loader; custom/dynamic loaders have no backend and return API_UNAVAILABLE rather than being ignored
Hierarchy resolution here is bounded dependency validation, not a complete ART verifier. Cycles/malformed hierarchy and resource budgets are structured errors
Default-bearing interface dependency scheduling is guarded in Class.forName; this change does not claim a complete global Java8 interface-initialization algorithm for every VM entry point
One-argument forName retains the loader of the runtime interpreted application DEX; no generalized VMStack/security-manager ecosystem is claimed
Actual Android reference device execution, corrected game first screens, and physical Switch validation were not run by these host tests
